newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to announce $850 mln trade gap in Nov-paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to announce $850 mln trade gap in Nov-paper.

text.p: Brazil is due to announce on Monday a trade deficit of $850 million in November, a local newspaper said.
Jornal do Brasil daily said November imports totalled about $4.76 billion against exports of $3.912 billion.
These figures would bring the trade deficit for the first 11 months of the year to more than $3.7 billion and for the whole of 1996 to over $4 billion, the newspaper said.
The Industry and Commerce Ministry is due to announce November's trade data at 1100 local/1300 GMT.
-- Fatima Cristina, Rio de Janeiro Newsroom, 55-21-5074151
